title: ジャパンCの後に・滾るこころ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to all her hard work leading up to this point, Grass Wonder claims victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her sights are now set on the Arima Kinen where a clash with Maruzensky awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, El Condor Pasa leaves the venue in a hurry, almost as if running away from Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Emotions whirl as the winds grow colder. Winter is on the horizon, but Grass Wonder's classic year is far from over yet…
